_instructions: --- HOW TO ADD AND LINK IMAGES ---
This file is a manifest for all images used in the Picture Atlas and tooltips.
Yes, the Picture Atlas updates automatically when you edit this file and `src/lib/constants.ts`.
Place your new image (e.g., 'my-new-image.jpg') into the `public/images/atlas/` directory.
Step 2: Add a new image entry below.
Inside the `placeholderImages` array, add a new JSON object for your image. It must have:
- `id`: A unique string to identify this image (e.g., 'my-new-image').
- `imageUrl`: The path to your image. This MUST start with '/images/atlas/'. (e.g., '/images/atlas/my-new-image.jpg').
- `imageHint`: One or two keywords for AI image search.
Step 3: Link the image to a lesion.
Open `src/lib/constants.ts`. Find the lesion you want to associate the image with.
Add the `id` from Step 2 to its `imageIds` array.
You can add as many image IDs as you need to the `imageIds` array for any lesion.
